{"decision": "push", "reason": "它把任意美国地址直接生成可导入 AutoCAD、SketchUp 和 GIS 的场地底图，是针对建筑和土木从业者的垂直小工具，用途明确，页面也具体描述了图层、等高线、土壤、洪涝区和示例文件。"}

verdict.reasoning: Every claim in the reason matches the project page: it generates a site base plan from any US address, exports for AutoCAD, SketchUp and GIS, and offers layers, contours, soils, flood zones and an example file. Calling the target users architects and civil engineers is a fair inference from the CAD targets. These concrete features support the push decision.
